personalInfo.name: Michael Chavez
personalInfo.bio: Experienced systems and data center technician specializing in cloud infrastructure, virtualization, media automation, and network topology. Passionate about architecting high-reliability systems, self-hosting privacy-first services, and automating everything in my home lab.

projects.name: Media Server Automation Pipeline
projects.description: Complete media automation stack running as native TrueNAS SCALE apps: Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr, Seerr, and Tdarr. Features Gluetun WireGuard VPN namespace isolation for qBittorrent, automated indexing via Prowlarr, and hardware-accelerated transcoding.

projects.name: Enterprise Gateway & Edge Defense
projects.description: Perimeter network powered by UniFi Dream Machine Pro ('Zeus') and UniFi U7 Lite ('Hermes'). Features Cloudflare Strict SSL with wildcard proxying (*.mikey.host), AdGuard Home DNS sinkhole, CrowdSec intrusion prevention, and Wazuh SIEM threat monitoring.

projects.name: Proxmox Virtualization Hypervisor
projects.description: Standalone Proxmox VE 9.0.5 hypervisor (pve01) hosting mission-critical Linux VMs and LXCs: 23-container Docker edge (docker1) managed through Portainer, Hermes Agent control node (clanker), Wazuh SIEM, and Crafty Minecraft LXC.

projects.name: High-Density TrueNAS SCALE Storage Server
projects.description: Enterprise-grade storage server powered by AMD Threadripper 3970X (32 cores / 64 threads) and 256 GB RAM. Manages multi-terabyte ZFS storage pools (Vault, Library, SSD-Locker) with automated scrubs, ARC cache tuning, and encrypted offsite snapshots.

projects.name: Smart Home & Autonomous Control Node
projects.description: Decentralized home automation and telemetry node running Home Assistant integrated with environment sensors, alongside the Hermes Agent autonomous control node (clanker) for infrastructure monitoring.

projects.name: Full-Stack Security Operations & SIEM
projects.description: Centralized SIEM monitoring with Wazuh Manager (VM 104) and CrowdSec IPS analyzing live ingress logs, providing real-time telemetry, automated threat banning, and SSL/DNS health checks.

experience.title: Data Center Technician 2
experience.description: Maintain Google Cloud server operations across mission-critical hardware, fiber network topologies, and global scale infrastructure.

experience.title: Level 2 Support Engineer
experience.description: Provided Tier-3 support and subject-matter expert input to internal and external enterprise customers, resolving complex infrastructure tickets and explaining advanced technical concepts in clear terms.

experience.title: Network Administrator - Consultant
experience.description: Architected and managed Active Directory (AD), Entra ID, DHCP, and DNS configurations, alongside enterprise Windows Server infrastructure to ensure 99.9% uptime and secure multi-site communication.

experience.title: R&D Technician
experience.description: Developed and executed rigorous validation protocols for high-performance computer hardware components. Collected diagnostic telemetry, optimized QA testing cycles, and collaborated directly with engineering teams to resolve component bottlenecks.

experience.title: Product Support Specialist
experience.description: Collaborated with hardware assemblers and system engineers to troubleshoot complex tier-2 hardware and firmware issues. Operated industrial QA machinery, performed deep component diagnostics, and authored standard operating procedures (SOPs).

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
education.details: Specialization in Network Engineering, Cloud Computing, and Infrastructure Architecture
